steps.inspect: Find the two thermocouple wire ends where they go into the connector ports. The copper wire looks gold or orange; the constantan wire looks silver or gray. Correct is gold copper in the LEFT port and silver constantan in the RIGHT port. If you can see the silver wire in the left port or the gold wire in the right port, the wires are reversed: that is the mistake, report it with high confidence. If the wire colors at the ports cannot be seen, it is not a mistake.

takeaway: the gold copper wire goes in the left port, and the silver constantan wire in the right. Swap them, and every temperature reads backwards.
intro: Today you'll wire a thermocouple into channel sixteen. I'm watching through your glasses: finish a step, take your hands away, and I'll check it.
complete: Done, good job! Now check the display: your channel should read the same as the others.
